MetaDataVersion.Name: Data Definitions for MSGv2.0 SDTM datasets.
MetaDataVersion.Description: This metadata version contains only a subset of SDTM domains available in the SDTMIG 3.3. The data contained do not represent the data which would appear together in an actual regulatory submission.
MetaDataVersion.def:ComputationMethod: EPOCH from SE where date >= SESTDTC and date < SEENDTC
Unique sequence number within each TSPARM, restarting at 1 for per TSPARM, applied to sorted data.
The first date/time of study drug. Null for screen failures.
The Date of Study Completion or Early Termination. Null for screen failures.
The first date/time of study drug administration. Null for subjects with no treatment data.
The last date/time of study drug administration. Null for subjects with no treatment data.
The latest date of assessment for the subject as determined by the End of Study Form, any scheduled assessments, Adverse Events, or Concomitant Medications.
If DTHDTC is populated then DTHFL='Y'
Unique sequence number within a subject, restarting at 1 for every subject, applied to sorted data.

SESTDTC if set to the --DTC for that subject which exists in the data for the defined start of the Element, such as DSSTDTC when DSDECOD=INFORMED CONSENT OBTAINED for Screening Elements or min(EXSTDTC) for Dosing Elements.
SEENDTC is set to the start of the next Element, or RFPENDTC for the last Element.
Study day relative to RFSTDTC. Date - RFSTDTC + 1 if on or after RFSTDTC. Date - RFSTDTC if date precedes RFSTDTC.
For each scheduled visit, SVSTDTC = the first (min) date associated with a subject for that visit. For unplanned visits, SVSTDTC is the date of the visit.
For each scheduled visit, SVENDTC = the last (max) date associated with a subject for that visit. For unplanned visits, SVENDTC is the date of the visit.
If CMENRTPT is populated, CMENTPT is DM.RFPENDTC for the subject.
EXDOSE = ECDOSE * ECPSTRG expressed in mg.
If AEENRTPT is populated, AEENTPT is DM.RFPENDTC for the subject.
If FTSTRESC is numeric then FTSTRESN=FTSTRESC in numeric format, else null.
Set to "Y" for last record with non-null original result on or before the first dose date (RFXSTDTC). Null otherwise.
If IECAT=INCLUSION then IEORRES=N, else if IECAT=EXCLUSION then IEORRES=Y
LBSTRESC is equal to LBORRES or the value in standard units if a conversion is necessary.
If --STRESC represents a numeric value then --STRESN is the numeric version of --STRESC, else null. "--" represents the domain code.
If QSSTRESC is numeric then QSSTRESN=QSSTRESC in numeric format, else null.

If QSORRES="Strongly disagree" then 1 If QSORRES="Disagree" then 2 If QSORRES="Slightly disagree" then 3 If QSORRES="Neither agree nor disagree" then 4 If QSORRES="Slightly agree" then 5 If QSORRES="Agree" then 6 If QSORRES="Strongly agree" then 7
RSSTRESC is the corresponding numeric value of RSORRES according the values shown on the HAMD-17 CRF page.
Data collected in conventional units (i.e. F, lbs, inches) is converted using standard conversion factors to standard units (C, kg, cm).
Starts at "1" for first device identifier and increments by one for each DIPARM
